info.title: Pav Enterprise API
info.description:
Read-only `/v1` API over Pav's biopharma dataset: drug programs, companies, clinical trials, deals, patent families, FDA records, a change feed, and dataset stats.

Authenticate every request with a Pav API key as a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Mint a key in [Pav developer settings](https://app.pav.bio/settings/developer).

All endpoints are `GET` and return JSON. List endpoints return a `{ data, pagination }` envelope. Pass `q=` to run relevance-ranked search that matches meaning as well as exact words; omit it for a filtered, paginated listing. Errors return `{ error: { code, message, request_id } }`.

get.description: Type-ahead suggestions for a program search box. Given a partial `q=` and optional active filters, runs the same search as `GET /v1/programs` and returns the top matching programs (company, drug, indication) — not facet values. Select one and filter by its `company_id`, or submit `q=` to `GET /v1/programs` for the full page.

get.description:
Search and filter the Pav pipeline of drug programs.

Provide `q=` to run relevance-ranked search that matches meaning as well as exact words (search responses report `pagination.total = null`). Omit `q=` for a filtered, sortable, paginated listing with optional exact totals via `include_total=true`. Filters and `q=` combine with AND.

Filter coverage note: `target` and `modality` have partial coverage in the source data. Filtering on a sparsely populated field restricts results to programs where that field is populated, which can shrink the result set.

get.description:
List clinical trials linked to one company, in the same role-aware shape as `/v1/trials/{nct_id}` (`lead_sponsor`, `collaborators`, `sponsors`, `company_ids`, `programs`).

A trial is linked to a company through either path:
- **program** — a Pav program the company owns is linked to the trial (`via=program`);
- **sponsor** — the trial's sponsor organization is linked to the company (`via=sponsor`).

`via=any` (default) returns the union. Pass `include_total=true` for an exact match count. Returns `404 not_found` if the company id is unknown.

get.description:

Every filter is optional and filters combine with AND. `q` is an exact-term match (word forms such as plurals also match; every term must match) over the deal name, event headline, summary and rights, or a substring of a party's name. It does not expand synonyms, so search each phrasing you care about. With no filters you get the most recent deal activity.

get.description:
FDA regulatory records with the applicant, sponsor or recipient linked to a Pav company where possible: Orange Book products, listed patents and exclusivities; Purple Book biologic products; orphan drug designations; warning letters; and drug/device recalls. Orange and Purple Book rows are the current monthly edition; warning letters and recalls are the published feed.

Every filter is optional and filters combine with AND. `q` is a case-insensitive substring of the title, description, company name, FDA organization name, or FDA identifier; it does not match synonyms. `company_id` returns only records linked to that company, so an unlinked record (common for warning letters and recalls) never matches it; search the FDA name with `q` as well.

Dates: `date_field=document_date` (default) filters on the date FDA issued the record; exclusivities have no issue date, so use `date_field=event_date` for expiries (patent, exclusivity), e.g. `record_type=orange_book_patent&date_field=event_date&date_from=2027-01-01&sort=event_date&direction=asc`.

get.summary: Get an FDA record by key
get.description: One FDA record by the `record_key` a list response returned. Orange Book, Purple Book and orphan designation keys belong to one FDA edition and stop working once FDA publishes the next edition; re-find the record with `GET /v1/fda?application_key=...` (or `product_key`, `patent_number`, `designation_id`). Warning-letter and recall keys are durable. Returns `404 not_found` for an unknown key.

latest_event_at.title: Latest Event At
latest_event_at.description: Date of the latest lifecycle event, when stated (UTC).

activity_date.title: Activity Date
activity_date.description: Latest activity: the latest event's date, else its source's publish date. Default sort key.

source_document_count.title: Source Document Count
source_document_count.description: Distinct source documents behind the deal.

event_count.title: Event Count
event_count.description: Lifecycle events recorded for the deal.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles the source documents give this party (e.g. acquirer, licensor).

deal_name.title: Deal Name
examples: Merck KGaA acquisition of Bio-Techne Corporation

latest_event_type.title: Latest Event Type
latest_event_type.description: Current lifecycle state. `update` means the latest mention changed no lifecycle state.

latest_event_name.title: Latest Event Name
latest_event_name.description: Headline of the latest lifecycle event.

latest_event_at.title: Latest Event At
latest_event_at.description: Date of the latest lifecycle event, when stated (UTC).

activity_date.title: Activity Date
activity_date.description: Latest activity: the latest event's date, else its source's publish date. Default sort key.

source_document_count.title: Source Document Count
source_document_count.description: Distinct source documents behind the deal.

event_count.title: Event Count
event_count.description: Lifecycle events recorded for the deal.

terms.description: Economics and rights across all source documents.

source_documents.title: Source Documents
source_documents.description: Source documents behind the deal, oldest first.

effective_at.title: Effective At
effective_at.description: Event date (UTC day): the source's stated date, else its publication date.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: URL of the document that reported this event.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When Pav first saw the document (UTC).

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: The term as the source states it.
examples: total enterprise value of approximately US$11.3 billion

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Monetary amount in base currency units. Null for percentages or unstated values.

not_disclosed.title: Not Disclosed
not_disclosed.description: True when the source explicitly withholds this term.

record_key.title: Record Key
record_key.description: Pav key for this record in the current FDA edition; pass it to `GET /v1/fda/{record_key}`. Orange Book, Purple Book and orphan designation keys include the edition, so they change when FDA publishes a new one. For a durable handle filter by `application_key`, `product_key`, `patent_number` or `designation_id`.

source.title: Source
source.description: FDA publication the record comes from.

source_version.title: Source Version
source_version.description: Source edition: `YYYY-MM` for Orange and Purple Book, the load date for orphan designations, null for warning letters and recalls (published continuously).

fda_organization_name.title: Fda Organization Name
fda_organization_name.description: Applicant, sponsor or recipient name as FDA spells it.

company.description: The Pav company this FDA organization is linked to. Null when unlinked: most Orange Book, Purple Book and orphan records are linked; most warning-letter and recall recipients (compounders, device and food makers) do not.

application_key.title: Application Key
application_key.description: FDA application: `N:` (NDA), `A:` (ANDA) or `BLA:` plus the number.

product_key.title: Product Key
product_key.description: Application plus the FDA product number.

patent_number.title: Patent Number
patent_number.description: Orange Book listed US patent number.

title.title: Title
title.description: Display title: trade name, patent or exclusivity label, subject, or brand.

description.title: Description
description.description: Ingredient or proper name for products, patents and exclusivities; the designated indication for orphan designations; the subject for warning letters; the product for recalls.

document_date.title: Document Date
document_date.description: Date FDA issued the record: approval, patent submission, designation, letter issue, or recall. Always null for exclusivities; null for some old products.

event_date.title: Event Date
event_date.description: The date `event_date_type` names, e.g. a patent expiry.

status.title: Status
status.description: Source status: marketing status for products (`RX`, `OTC`, `DISCN`, ...), `listed`/`delisted` for patents, the exclusivity code for exclusivities, the designation status, `issued`/`closed` for warning letters, `active`/`terminated` for recalls.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Official FDA page for the record. Null for Orange and Purple Book rows.

ingredient.title: Ingredient
ingredient.description: Orange Book active ingredient(s) as FDA lists them.

dosage_route.title: Dosage Route
dosage_route.description: Orange Book dosage form and route, `FORM;ROUTE`.

therapeutic_equivalence_code.title: Therapeutic Equivalence Code
therapeutic_equivalence_code.description: Orange Book therapeutic-equivalence (TE) code; set only for multisource products.

reference_listed_drug.title: Reference Listed Drug
reference_listed_drug.description: Orange Book: the product is a reference listed drug (RLD).

reference_standard.title: Reference Standard
reference_standard.description: Orange Book: the product is the reference standard (RS).

patent_use_code.title: Patent Use Code
patent_use_code.description: Orange Book patent use code (method-of-use claim), when listed.

pediatric_extension.title: Pediatric Extension
pediatric_extension.description: Orange Book patent: the expiry includes pediatric exclusivity.

drug_substance_claim.title: Drug Substance Claim
drug_substance_claim.description: Orange Book patent claims the drug substance. Null when not flagged.

drug_product_claim.title: Drug Product Claim
drug_product_claim.description: Orange Book patent claims the drug product. Null when not flagged.

license_number.title: License Number
license_number.description: Purple Book US license number of the holder.

reference_product_exclusivity_expiry.title: Reference Product Exclusivity Expiry
reference_product_exclusivity_expiry.description: Purple Book 12-year reference product exclusivity expiry.

generic_name.title: Generic Name
generic_name.description: Orphan designation: generic name as the sponsor filed it.

marketing_approval_date.title: Marketing Approval Date
marketing_approval_date.description: Orphan designation: marketing approval date, once approved.

exclusivity_end_date.title: Exclusivity End Date
exclusivity_end_date.description: Orphan designation: orphan exclusivity end date.

approved_labeled_indication.title: Approved Labeled Indication
approved_labeled_indication.description: Orphan designation: the approved labeled indication.

reason_description.title: Reason Description
reason_description.description: Recall reason as FDA describes it.

product_types.title: Product Types
product_types.description: Recall product types. Food-only recalls are excluded from this feed.

issuing_office.title: Issuing Office
examples: Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER)

closeout_date.title: Closeout Date
closeout_date.description: Warning letter close-out date, once FDA closed it out.

FdaRecordDetails.title: FdaRecordDetails
FdaRecordDetails.description: Source fields for one record. Each field applies to the record types named in it.

ontology.title: Ontology
ontology.description: Ontology of the indication term (e.g. MONDO).

source_text.title: Source Text
source_text.description: Indication text the term was mapped from.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of rows returned for this request.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Zero-based row offset applied before returning results.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total matching rows across all pages. Null on relevance-ranked search responses and on listings requested without `include_total`.

representative_title.title: Representative Title
representative_title.description: Title of the family's representative member.
examples: GLUCAGON LIKE PEPTIDE 1 (GLP-1) FUSION PEPTIDE ... CONJUGATES AND USES THEREOF

latest_status_date.title: Latest Status Date
latest_status_date.description: Most recent status change on any member. Default sort key.

has_live_member.title: Has Live Member
has_live_member.description: True when any member is pending or in force.

owner_names.title: Owner Names
owner_names.description: Recorded owners of the live members. Empty for a lapsed family.

owner_is_split.title: Owner Is Split
owner_is_split.description: True when live members have different owners.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Owners linked to Pav companies. About a quarter of families map to a company, so an empty list does not mean the company holds no patents.

members.title: Members
members.description: Member applications, newest filed first. Present with `include_members=true`.

has_live_member.title: Has Live Member
has_live_member.description: True when any member is pending or in force.

owner_names.title: Owner Names
owner_names.description: Owners of the live members; for a lapsed family, owners across all members.

owner_is_split.title: Owner Is Split
owner_is_split.description: True when live members have different owners.

has_open_security_interest.title: Has Open Security Interest
has_open_security_interest.description: True when any member carries an open security interest.

latest_maintenance_fee_date.title: Latest Maintenance Fee Date
latest_maintenance_fee_date.description: Most recent maintenance-fee payment on any member.

statutory_term_start.title: Statutory Term Start
statutory_term_start.description: Earliest nonprovisional filing the family claims (35 USC 154(a)(2)). Null when an ancestor's filing date is unknown.

statutory_term_end.title: Statutory Term End
statutory_term_end.description: `statutory_term_start` plus 20 years. Term adjustments and extensions are not applied.

events.title: Events
events.description: Prosecution and maintenance events, newest first (capped).

patent_number.title: Patent Number
patent_number.description: Granted patent number; null until granted.

role.title: Role
role.description: Member's place in the family (root, continuation, ...).

is_dead.title: Is Dead
is_dead.description: True when the application is abandoned or expired.

has_open_security_interest.title: Has Open Security Interest
has_open_security_interest.description: True when an open security interest (lien) is recorded on this member.

patent_number.title: Patent Number
patent_number.description: Granted patent number; null until granted.

role.title: Role
role.description: Member's place in the family (root, continuation, ...).

is_dead.title: Is Dead
is_dead.description: True when the application is abandoned or expired.

application_numbers.title: Application Numbers
application_numbers.description: Members the conveyance was recorded on.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: The trial's primary endpoint measure (what is being assessed).

time_frame.title: Time Frame
time_frame.description: Time frame over which the primary outcome is measured.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description/definition of the primary outcome.
examples: Patients are considered a failure if they die, progress, or relapse.

id.title: Id
id.description: Durable Pav program identifier. Stable over time and kept when a program is discontinued, so a stored id keeps working.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state of the program: `active` while the company still publishes it, or `discontinued` once it drops off the pipeline. List and search endpoints return only `active` programs; a single-program lookup by id still returns a `discontinued` one.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier that owns this program.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Company slug, a stable readable identifier.

company.title: Company
company.description: Display name of the company that owns this program.

drug.title: Drug
drug.description: Drug or asset name for the program.

indication.title: Indication
indication.description: Indication the program targets, as published by the company.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Development phase as published by the company (raw label).

phase_norm.title: Phase Norm
phase_norm.description: Phase normalized to Pav's phase vocabulary (e.g. `Phase 2`).

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: Drug modality as published by the company (raw label).

modality_norm.title: Modality Norm
modality_norm.description: Modality normalized to Pav's modality vocabulary. Null when the modality is not known.

target.title: Target
target.description: Molecular target of the asset. Coverage is partial — many programs have no published target and this field is null for them.

mechanism_of_action.title: Mechanism Of Action
mechanism_of_action.description: Mechanism of action for the asset.

territory.title: Territory
territory.description: Territory/region the program applies to, when disclosed.

description.title: Description
examples: Oral GLP-1 receptor agonist for type 2 diabetes and obesity.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Additional program notes from the source.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Collaboration/partnership entries associated with the program.

clinical_trials.title: Clinical Trials
clinical_trials.description: Clinical trials linked to this program.

indication_terms.title: Indication Terms
indication_terms.description: Ontology (MONDO) terms mapped from the program's indication.

target_terms.title: Target Terms
target_terms.description: Ontology (NCIT/HGNC) terms mapped from the program's target.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: URL of the company page the program was read from.

source_checked_at.title: Source Checked At
source_checked_at.description: When Pav last read the source page (UTC).

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Stable company id — send back as a `company_id` filter.

ProgramSuggestion.title: ProgramSuggestion
ProgramSuggestion.description: One search-as-you-type suggestion: a concrete program, not a facet value.

program_id.title: Program Id
program_id.description: The program the similar set was computed for.

data.title: Data
data.description: Programs most similar to the source program, ranked by similarity.

name.title: Name
name.description: Sponsor organization name exactly as recorded on ClinicalTrials.gov.

role.title: Role
role.description: Sponsor role on the trial: `lead_sponsor`, `collaborator`, or `owner`.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier this sponsor is linked to. Null when the sponsor is not a tracked company.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Slug of the Pav company this organization is linked to, when linked.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Total number of pipeline programs tracked.

distinct_phases.title: Distinct Phases
distinct_phases.description: Count of distinct normalized phases present.

distinct_modalities.title: Distinct Modalities
distinct_modalities.description: Count of distinct normalized modalities present.

by_phase.title: By Phase
by_phase.description: Program counts grouped by normalized phase.

by_modality.title: By Modality
by_modality.description: Program counts grouped by normalized modality.

ontology.title: Ontology
ontology.description: Ontology of the target term (NCIT or HGNC).

source_text.title: Source Text
source_text.description: Target text the term was mapped from.

nct_url.title: Nct Url
nct_url.description: ClinicalTrials.gov URL for the trial record.

title.title: Title
title.description: Official or brief title of the trial.
examples: A Study of a Vaccine to Prevent COVID-19

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Trial phase as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

status.title: Status
status.description: Overall recruitment/operational status of the trial.

program_count.title: Program Count
program_count.description: Number of Pav programs linked to this trial.

company_short_names.title: Company Short Names
company_short_names.description: Slugs of companies whose Pav programs are linked to this trial. For sponsor-based links as well, see `company_ids` and `sponsors`.

lead_sponsor.description: Lead sponsor as recorded on ClinicalTrials.gov. Null when the registry record names no sponsor organization (e.g. some pre-2016 records).

collaborators.title: Collaborators
collaborators.description: Collaborator sponsors as recorded on ClinicalTrials.gov.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.description: All sponsors (lead, collaborators, owners), lead sponsor first.

company_ids.title: Company Ids
company_ids.description: Pav company ids linked to this trial as a sponsor or through their programs (deduplicated, sorted). Use them to join trials to companies and programs.

programs.title: Programs
programs.description: Pav programs linked to this trial.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Trial start date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

last_update_post_date.title: Last Update Post Date
last_update_post_date.description: Date the trial record was last updated on ClinicalTrials.gov.

primary_completion_date.title: Primary Completion Date
primary_completion_date.description: Primary completion date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov — the date the last participant was examined or received an intervention for primary-outcome data collection. A key resolution date.

completion_date.title: Completion Date
completion_date.description: Study completion date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

results_first_post_date.title: Results First Post Date
results_first_post_date.description: Date results were first posted on ClinicalTrials.gov. Null until the trial has posted results.

why_stopped.title: Why Stopped
why_stopped.description: Free-text reason the trial stopped early, as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov. Null for trials that did not stop early.

primary_outcomes.title: Primary Outcomes
primary_outcomes.description: The trial's primary outcome measures (primary endpoints) as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

program_id.title: Program Id
program_id.description: Durable Pav program identifier linked to this trial.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Slug of the company that owns the linked program.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier that owns the linked program.

drug.title: Drug
drug.description: Drug/asset name of the linked program.

error.description: Error detail. Present only on 4xx/5xx responses.

request_id.description: Correlation id echoed in the `X-Request-ID` response header. Quote it when contacting Pav support about a failed request.
request_id.title: Request Id

EnterpriseApiKey.description: Use a personal or organization Pav API key from Pav developer settings. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

tags.name: programs
tags.description: Search and filter drug pipeline assets by company, indication, target, modality, phase, or free text. Includes get-by-id, similar-programs, and facet autocomplete.

tags.name: companies
tags.description: Tracked biopharma companies and their pipeline ownership. List a company's programs and change history.

tags.name: trials
tags.description: Search clinical trials — ClinicalTrials.gov records plus Pav program/company links. Relevance-ranked search when `q=` is set; filtered browse otherwise.

tags.name: deals
tags.description: Biopharma deals (M&A, licensing, collaborations, options, joint ventures) from SEC filings and press releases, with lifecycle state, headline economics, and source documents.

tags.name: patents
tags.description: US patent families from USPTO with owners linked to Pav companies, member applications, ownership history, and statutory term.

tags.name: fda
tags.description: FDA records with applicants linked to Pav companies: Orange Book products, patents and exclusivities, Purple Book biologics, orphan designations, warning letters, and recalls.

tags.name: changes
tags.description: Detected pipeline movement events per company — added and removed assets and phase changes — with before/after phase and detection time.

tags.name: stats
tags.description: High-level dataset counts and facet coverage.
